# Filter players with more than 5 league goals and 0 in all other competitions
filtered = df[(df['League'] > 5) & 
              (df['FA Cup'] == 0) & 
              (df['League Cup'] == 0) & 
              (df['JP Trophy'] == 0)]

# Get the first matching player's name
answer = filtered['Name'].iloc[0] if not filtered.empty else None
answer
